description:
Yep, today I am making Kraft Cheese Gelato. If you love Kraft cheese, this is definitely one for you. 

What you'll need:

436g Milk @ 2% fat 
110g Cream @ 33% fat 
75g Kraft Cheese Powder
100g Sugar
30g Dextrose
1g Guar Gum

It's pretty simple to make and the texture is great. Are you a lover of Kraft Cheese? Let me know in the comments and also what unusual flavour I should make next month. 

------------------------------

Do you know what Milo is? Well the Aussies do 🇦🇺 ! Why not have a look if you like malt flavours. 
https://youtu.be/j-8ZS-sbufk?si=LRWyBfrmR2gvCgv3

-----------------------------

You don't like malt? Ok then check out this Ben & Jerry's Karamel Sutra remake, it's delicious 🤤 :
https://youtu.be/MDFSO3ZTOUQ?si=ar4uRTZgJEoTIWf7

comments.text:
I'll throw my hat in... Parmesan ice cream with ribbons of aged balsamic. Pears/canned pears for sweetness instead of sugar. Nutmeg, shallots, a splash of fish sauce, etc. Making almost more of a savory ice cream with hints of sweetness/flavor from the pears and punches of solid complex sweetness from the balsamic. If you are planning to put through a fine strainer and want to go crazy, add a can of crushed sardines into the steep - that will amplify the umami. After straining, you can mix all the solids into some softened goat cheese for a nice spread and to not waste anything.

Hmm... To be honest, I'd probably use some allulose to help lower the freezing point, etc. That would help keep the base sweetness more in the background while still helping with the functionality of making ice cream.

There is a youtube channel called 'awarehousechef" who made a faux aged balsamic. Basically a balsamic glaze, but higher quality and better taste than the ones you can buy in the stores.
